organization: FAU Erlangen-Nuremberg (Hartmann/Schmidt groups; Marti, Wolf, Schmidt, Hartmann et al.)
notes: Thermodynamic-limit dispersion relations on trapped-ion quantum hardware. Runs a numerical linked-cluster expansion with a quantum algorithm (NLCE+QA) on a 20-qubit trapped-ion QPU, computing ground-state energies and one-quasiparticle dispersions in the thermodynamic limit for transverse-field Ising models; explores whether current hardware gives expectation values accurate enough to survive nonlinear classical post-processing. RELEVANCE 3/5: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMS the measurement-noise wall for VQE/adiabatic TFIM preparation on real hardware -- consistent with task #95's finding that the ADAPT state's force observable is noise-fragile. Same critical-Ising target as our MERA work. Does not change physics anchors.
